name: accountant-agent
description: Masterclass challenge: an accountant agent that turns a month of invoices, receipts, bank statements and Stripe payments into checked tables, a reconciliation and a review list for a person, with every value quoted from its source and every sum done by a script.

interface.shortDescription: Invoices in, checked fields and a reconciled month out.
interface.longDescription: Sets up and runs the Agentic AI Masterclass accountant challenge: collect a fictional company's September documents, extract fields with their source line, check the sums with a script, reconcile bank and Stripe, and prepare a DRAFT package for the tax adviser. Nothing is paid or sent.
defaultPrompt: Set up my accountant agent for the AI Realist masterclass.
